Enabled.description: Enable collection for this surface. Frontend additionally requires @Html.AddClientTrace().

UseSourceMaps.description: Attempt browser-side source map translation; retain original reports if mapping fails.

ExcludedScripts.description: Exact script paths or HTTP(S) URLs, or patterns using * as the only wildcard. Ignore query strings and fragments.

ExcludedPaths.description: Exact page paths or patterns using * as the only wildcard. Matching is case-sensitive and excludes query strings and fragments.

ExcludeUnidentifiedScripts.description: Discard reports for which no script can be identified.
